messages.content: Answer with a list of items, instead of bullet points use -. No two consecutive words can share the same first letter. write a description of the 20th century in an over-dramatic, biblical style

message.content:
- Dawn broke, but darkness held fast.
- Kings fell, and dust swallowed stone.
- Fire raged across oceans wide.
- Silence screamed, then voices roared loud.
- Empires crumbled; hope hung thin.
- Machines hummed, yet hearts broke often.
